purpose: Bind claim, contrast, population, estimand, stopping, and conclusion before outcomes.
rules: Every causal claim has at least one sealed treatment and one valid sealed counterfactual.
Arm selection follows claim class; no universal arm bundle is implied.
Assignments and reviewer allocation commit before any outcome is observed.
Stopping, retry, qualification, analysis, judging, and recommendation policies seal before execution.
Post-seal changes create a new revision and never rewrite a campaign.
